text:
Alice: Anyone else seeing silence from the paging pipeline? I tried to trigger a page for INC-2026 and nothing went out to the provider, channel is quiet.
Ben: I'm seeing a bunch of 502/503 in pager-bridge logs around now. Pulling metrics.
Carol: Quick check — we rotated the signing keys in infra ~03:44 UTC for the bridge. Could be signing mismatch.
Alice: IncidentBot shows internal 'sent' for the message but provider heartbeat shows no inbound. So internal ack != external delivery.
Ben: Looking at tcpdump between pager-relay (10.4.2.7) and pager-proxy: TLS handshake reset repeatedly, client hello then RST.
Sam-Ops: @Carol did the cert/key rotation include the relay config? If the relay still has old signing, provider rejects.
Carol: I only rotated the signing key used by the control-plane pubsub. I didn't touch the relay certs, but there was a deploy earlier that changed header signing behavior — DeployBot did a rollout at 1745609952.
DeployBot: Deploy started: pager-header-normalization v2 -> rolled to 30% at 1745609952
Alice: Can we try a manual test with the old signature format? I'll craft a curl to the internal publish endpoint.
Ben: Paste the curl you used.
Alice: ```bash
curl -v -X POST 'https://pager-relay.internal/_publish'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -H 'X-Incident-Signature: sha256=oldsig123'
  -d '{"alert":"test-page","id":"test-1745609999"}'
```
Ben: Got a 200 internally but on the outbound side I still see TLS resets. Provider side says: "no connection established".
Carol: I can re-run the relay with debug logs and disable the new header normalization to confirm. Rolling a temporary revert to config v1.
Sam-Ops: Meanwhile flip to SMS fallback for customers who reported undelivered pages. @Alice can you trigger the fallback for the two affected customers?
Alice: Done, routed via sms-fallback-proxy, both customers confirmed receipt via support channel.
IncidentBot: pager-relay restarted at 1745610005 (user: Carol) — reason: debug-restart
Ben: After restart, relay establishes TLS but we're still seeing a handful of queued messages stuck in outbox. They look like they failed earlier with ERR_HANDSHAKE.
Alice: Running explicit flush now: ```bash
curl -X POST 'https://pager-relay.internal/_admin/flush-queue' -H 'Authorization: Bearer redwood-admin'```
Ben: Flush succeeded, outbound queue drained, provider returned 202 for those messages.
Sam-Ops: Confirming customers got pages via primary now? Support says yes, both acknowledged. Marking customer impact as limited (2 customers, 8 minutes delay).
Carol: Root cause appears to be a race between header normalization rollout and a signing key epoch flip; relay and provider had transient mismatch causing handshake resets. We reverted the rollout and re-synced signing keys.
Alice: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to Carol for the postmortem and checklist updates.
Carol: Taking lead. Action items: add canary synthetic page every 1m that validates end-to-end delivery, add an alert for consecutive ERR_HANDSHAKE > 3 in 1m, add automated pre-rollout signing parity check.
Ben: Also log improvement: include provider TLS alert code in relay logs for easier triage.
Sam-Ops: I'll file the incident ticket and tag infra/relay/ops. ETA postmortem draft in 24h.
Carol: Closing channel updates — we have pages recovered and fallbacks used. Will publish incident summary once ticket is up.
